weeks.content:
Complete memorization of Surah Al-Quraysh
(Verses 3-4); Tajweed rules; Lessons about gratitude
to Allah; The blessings of trade and security

Introduction to Angels (Malaikah); What are
Angels? Angels are created from light;
Characteristics of Angels (they obey Allah, never
disobey, never sleep or eat)

Names and duties of major Angels: Jibril
(revelation), Mikail (rain/sustenance), Israfil
(trumpet), Izrail (death); Angel Kiraman Katibin
(recording deeds); Angel Malik (guardian of Hell)

What are Jinn? Creation of Jinn from fire; Types of
Jinn (believers and disbelievers); Story of Iblis
(Shaytan); Iblis refuses to bow to Adam

How Shaytan misleads people; Ways to protect
ourselves from Shaytan (seeking refuge in Allah,
reciting Qur'an, remembering Allah); Du'a for
protection: A'udhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajeem

Importance of valid prayer; Things that invalidate
Salat: Talking during prayer, eating or drinking,
turning away from Qiblah, laughing loudly

More things that invalidate Salat: Breaking Wudu
during prayer, intentional movements, adding or
omitting pillars; What to do if Salat is spoiled;
Making up missed prayers

Review of all topics covered in second term; Qur'an
recitation practice
End of second term assessment (written and oral)
